subject: Nanotechnology
title: Why Nano Transforms Energy
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Why Nano Transforms Energy.

hook.text: The sun delivers 10,000 times more energy than humanity uses — nano is key to capturing more of it efficiently.

buildup.text: Nanomaterials offer huge surface areas, tunable bandgaps, and quantum effects that bulk materials lack.

discovery.text: These properties accelerate charge transfer, boost light absorption, and enable new energy conversion pathways.

twist.text: Scaling nano from lab to factory is expensive — manufacturing cost often erases the efficiency gains.

climax.text: Roll-to-roll printing and solution processing are cutting costs — nano energy devices are reaching market scale.

punchline.text: Nano turns abundant sunlight into affordable electricity — surface by surface.

quiz.question: Why do nanomaterials improve energy devices?
options: They are heavier and store more energy
High surface areas, tunable bandgaps, and quantum effects enhance energy conversion
They reflect light better than bulk materials
